findings.claim: The best-lap store is read only once, in reset(). Later, `state.bestLapMs` is a stale snapshot of storage. If the stored best changes while a race is running (a second tab, window or installed-PWA instance on the same origin), a lap that beats the stale snapshot overwrites a faster stored best with a slower time. It also shows the NEW BEST chip and the NEW BEST LAP results label for a lap that is not the best.
findings.evidence: `bestLapMs: info.trackId === undefined ? null : bestLaps.read(info.trackId)` (line 95) is the only read. The write decision is `if (state.bestLapMs !== null && ms >= state.bestLapMs) continue; state.bestLapMs = ms; ... bestLaps.write(race.trackId, ms); newBestTick = lapEnd;` (lines 122-126). Trace: storage has no `racer.bestLap.dust-bowl`. `game.startRace({trackId:'dust-bowl', seed:5})`: HUD BEST shows dashes and `state.bestLapMs` is null. Another tab runs `localStorage.setItem('racer.bestLap.dust-bowl','1000')`. Drive lap 1 (~17 s, about 1000 ticks) with the twin-bot inputs. Lap 1 is not slower than null, so `write` runs: storage becomes '17xxx.xx', no longer '1000', and the NEW BEST chip becomes visible. AC3 says that with a stored best faster than every lap, the stored value is still '1000' after the laps. A test that sets storage after startRace() fails.
findings.suggestedFix: Re-read the store when a lap ends, before the comparison in the lap loop: `const stored = race.trackId === undefined ? null : bestLaps.read(race.trackId); if (stored !== null && (state.bestLapMs === null || stored < state.bestLapMs)) state.bestLapMs = stored;`. This costs one storage read per completed lap, not per frame. Blocked or empty storage still reads as null, so AC1-AC7 are unaffected.

checked.target: src/ui/race-ui.ts sync(): multi-lap loop and lapEnd
checked.how: Read src/sim/race.ts updateRacer: lapTicks holds per-lap durations and lapStartTick accumulates, so sum(lapTicks) equals raceTick at the end of the last lap. raceView.raceTick = tick − COUNTDOWN_TICKS, same origin. newBestTick = lapEnd lines up with view.raceTick; batched laps are taken in order.

BACK = ceil(2200·60/1000) = 132, GONE = ceil(2400·60/1000) = 144, both exact in floating point. since=131 gives 'out' (visible), since=144 gives null (hidden), matching AC4. The since<0 guard is only reachable with inconsistent stage data.

checked.target: State leaking between races and restarts
checked.how: reset() re-creates `state`, nulls raceBestMs and newBestTick, zeroes lapsSeen, sets race=info and calls hud.newBest(null). results.show() sets bestLabel every time, so no stale 'New best lap'. game.startRace always calls ui.reset before draw().

checked.target: Pause, resume and tab-hidden interplay with the chip
checked.how: The chip phase is driven by sim raceTick, so it freezes while paused or when rAF stops. Nothing is stranded: reset clears it and the results overlay covers the HUD. The setPaused/resume/visibilitychange paths are unchanged by the diff.

checked.target: Listeners, timers, rAF and DOM nodes added by the diff
checked.how: Grepped the diff: no addEventListener, setTimeout or rAF is added. The chip is one permanent node created once in createHud. best-laps.ts has no module-level storage access, so it imports cleanly in Node.

read() and write() wrap every window.localStorage access (including the getter) in try/catch. parse() rejects null, '', 'abc', '-5', '0', 'Infinity' via Number.isFinite && >0. String(ms) round-trips to the same double, so an identical re-driven lap is a tie, not a new best.

The chip inherits .ui-hud{pointer-events:none}, so it never intercepts touches. .ui-hud__timer{isolation:isolate} keeps BEST's z-index:1 below the pause/results overlays. out→back animates, out→null cuts. Reduced motion: .is-back hidden (later rule wins). --duration-slide and --ease-snap exist in tokens.css.

checked.target: Results chip semantics and edge cases
checked.how: results.show gets bestLapMs: raceBestMs (this race's min, non-null once finished) and newBest: newBestTick !== null. Lap and finish are pushed in the same tick, so a last-lap new best is seen before show(). Ties and slower laps leave newBest false. No trackId means no read, write or chip.
The diff touches no src/sim file. game.ts only adds trackId to the ui.reset info. No Date, Math.random or wall-clock use was added. Gates G2/G3 pass: bot laps +0.0%, replays reproduced.

The in-memory store is created per raceStage call, so there is no cross-render leak. Existing stages pass no storedBestMs, so no trackId and no storage access. Stage arithmetic checks out: hud raceTick 2452 = 2422+30 gives 'out'; finish ticks 4836/4932/4993/5067 match positions 1-4. Uses stageTrack().id.

checked.target: Existing tests that could be disturbed
checked.how: Read tests/ui/race-ui.test.ts (no-DOM-write frame, finish text '0:38.33'), hud.test.ts and stages.test.ts. newBest() caches its phase and returns early. Without a trackId, raceBestMs equals the old min(lapTicks). The +2 in the 621/603 test count are the two new stages.

checked.target: Capture harness determinism with real localStorage
checked.how: Read harness/screens/capture.ts: fresh browser context per viewport, races keyed per track. Real best laps persist, but no stored best leaks between viewport passes.

Fixed seeds with bot-derived inputs; localStorage cleared and rAF stubbed in beforeEach. visibleNewBest toggles with aria-hidden (rest 'true', shown 'false'), so it is non-vacuous. AC3, AC5 and AC6 fail on main. Names AC1-AC8 all present.

No colour or size literals, environment sniffing or inline style added. NEW_BEST_HOLD_MS=2000 has no token (tokens.json motion.durationMs has no hold); it comes from board 05. source-rules.test.ts patterns do not match the new CSS.

checked.target: Chip height vs BEST chip (possible 3px mismatch)
checked.how: The chip is a block div on a 16px font with line-height:1 around a 13px inline span, so its line box is likely about 16px against BEST's 13px flex item. Layout cannot be run here, and any overlap is confined to the first or last slide frame, so not reported.
